9.text: GENERAL CHARACTER OF RUSSIAN ADMINISTRATION. — Such is the history

10.text: of the official influence of the Russians upon their Chukchee neighbors. To

11.text: understand it properly, one must bear in mind the general character of the

12.text: Russian Administration in the far east of Siberia. The rule of the Moscow

13.text: Government, which lasted in European Russia until the beginning of the

14.text: eighteenth century, continued in Siberia half a century longer. Thus all the
